name: Mrok
source:
"You guys are so annoying! Don't all give me directions one by one!"

An associate of Adele that is pursuing the protagonist's group.
He can't trust anyone and is only following Adele for his own purposes.
His brutal and lunatic seeming behavior is his trademark.
